title: Current Cloud Connected restrictions conflict with the general Agent Mode path
problem: The feature guide describes Agent Mode through Cloud Connected on 2.1+, while current installation compatibility excludes 2.2.0–2.3.6 and says its 2.1.1 fallback lacks Agent Mode. SAIA-9918 independently records current access failure.

versions: planned 2.4.0 is not established as released
audiences: Readers evaluating a current Enterprise Agent Mode path
exclusions: No native Cloud restriction, actual tenant availability, supported future release, entitlement or customer authorization is inferred.

scopeComparison: General feature requirements and current installation/known-issue restrictions both concern Enterprise Cloud Connected. Keep the current block and the disagreement visible; neither a minimum comparison nor planned 2.4.0 support establishes a current usable path. Native Cloud remains separate.

impact.customerScenario: A reader planning Enterprise Agent Mode from the documented 2.1+ feature minimum.
impact.consequence: Meeting a minimum or selecting a listed AWS region cannot establish current Cloud Connected compatibility. Vendor reconciliation and exact supported released scope are required.

confidence.rationale: Three exact official indexed sections were compared; raw body hashes and tenant verification are unavailable.

lifecycle.reason: Current scope disagreement remains; no resolution or tenant eligibility inferred.

evidence.statement: Current installation guidance excludes Cloud Connected for SAIA 2.2.0 through 2.3.6. Its fallback is 2.1.1, explicitly without Agent Mode. Planned 2.4.0 support in late November is not released availability.
